ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

ru: Видел ли ты того, кто считает ложью Суд?
Это тот, кто грубо отталкивает сироту
en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer[2000] -
Those who make show [of their deeds]
en_fn: [2000] i.e., the hypocrites who are unconcerned if they miss prayers when no one sees them.
